title: Day 24: From Ruin to Luxury Pool 😍
short_title: Day 24: From Ruin to Luxury Pool 😍
hook: Watch this pool turn into luxury
caption: Day 24 of turning abandoned places into luxury 🏚️➡️✨ Same pool, completely new life 🔨 👉 Share with a friend, subscribe for a new makeover every day, and comment if you want more like this!
narration: Could you fix a pool this bad? First they repaired the cracked walls. Then they laid new stone around the edge, and set up loungers and lights. Same pool. Completely new life.
